curiosities: It is an Atari 65XE computer in a console case, with a detachable keyboard and a light gun.
Missile Command is built into it.
It plays the existing cartridges and software of the Atari 8-bit computers.
Its XG-1 light gun also works with the Atari 2600 and 7800.
Bug Hunt and Barnyard Blaster were made for its light gun.
Atari sold it alongside the 7800 and the 2600 Jr.
bestsellers: Archon: The Light and the Dark
